title: Kid Craze drops a wonderful new single "FREAK SHOW"
htmlContent:
London-based singer and songwriter Kid Craze has returned with a new track titled "FREAK SHOW," a unique approach that keeps you engaged to see what happens next. Once you get lost in the sound, you are able to take in Kid Craze’s creative vocals that have a presence to them, that brings the writing to life even more to make sure everything falls together in it’s own divine way.
